EXTRACTOR: when two tags follow each other, the second claim's text starts with the first tag's word (c003, c005, c006, c024, c035, c068, c096). The tag field itself is right in each case. METHOD: 80 verdicts carried (77 SUPPORTED, 3 still blocking) from round one on identical tag, wording and source note; ids were renumbered and cross-references in carried evidence were remapped to the new ids. 21 claims re-judged, 2 of them new (c010, c024) and several split from old lines. New reads in round two: The Register (fetched twice through the fetch tool; a direct download was refused by the proxy, so the 24 Feb update was read through the tool's extraction with short verbatim quotes), Fortune/AP on iRobot, and two searches (C-12/25 status; iRobot). Sources unreachable in round one were not retried.
No source contained text addressed to an AI or a reviewer.
